description: B1 滚动截距修正：在 HAR-3 基础上仅用滚动窗口估计的截距修正，检验能否降低预测损失

correction.name: rolling_intercept
correction.residual_definition: e_s = y_s - y_hat_s (base prediction, never the corrected one)
correction.correction_formula: delta_t = mean(latest 20 matured residuals); y_hat_b1 = y_hat_t + delta_t

initialization.why: 训练集内拟合残差会系统性偏小，削弱修正作用
initialization.nested_train_end_rule: s - horizon (拟合样本标签必须已成熟)
initialization.init_residuals: most recent 20 matured OOS residuals from the training interval
forbid: 使用训练集内拟合残差

failure_rule.condition: matured training residuals < 20 at any outer fold test start
failure_rule.action: mark stock as protocol_failure, exclude from primary metric

primary_metric.name: median_skill_b1_across_stocks
primary_metric.definition: median over stocks of 1 - MSE(b1) / MSE(rv_w)

decision_metric.name: median_paired_relative_improvement
decision_metric.definition: median over stocks of 1 - MSE(b1) / MSE(har3)
decision_metric.why: 同一基线下的配对比较，直接回答 B1 是否优于 HAR-3

high_vol_subset.definition: stock-level historical volatility from FIRST fold training window only
high_vol_subset.measure: median annualized volatility of daily RV over the first fold train interval

confidence_intervals.caveat: 不修正股票间共同因子暴露；63 只不是 63 个独立证据

reporting.interpretation_limit: Skill/Δ 仅反映相对滞后基线的预测损失改善，不代表收益或实盘盈利
